findings.summary: When splitting failed batches or retrying singletons, the work queue incorrectly pushes the next attempt with `batchStartSha: itemBatchStartSha` instead of the newly evaluated `activeBatchStartSha`. Because `itemBatchStartSha` retains the original pre-poll `runningStartSha` from the start of the orchestration run, this causes a final exhaustion rollback on any subsequent batch's comment to inadvertently revert all successful commits from previously completed batches in the same run.
findings.suggested_fix: In the three places where `workQueue.push` is called for next attempts (approx. lines 501, 524, 723), change `batchStartSha: itemBatchStartSha` to `batchStartSha: activeBatchStartSha` so that the retry isolate its rollback correctly.
